result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant names in the Fastest near you carousel and inconsistent delivery-time badge placement on restaurant cards.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off on the third card in the Fastest near you row, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or give cards enough width so full names display without clipping.

issues.description: Delivery time badges are inconsistently placed on Fastest near you cards—bottom-left on the first card vs. bottom-center on the second and third—creating a messy, uneven look.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge position (e.g. always bottom-left or top-left) across all cards in the carousel.
